raw.query: WITH x AS (SELECT model, signal, b.bin, (b.v->>'n')::bigint AS n, (b.v->>'cov10')::double precision AS cov10, (b.v->>'cov50')::double precision AS cov50, (b.v->>'cov90')::double precision AS cov90, (b.v->>'band')::double precision AS band FROM provenance.quantile_coverage q CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(q.detail) b(bin,v)) SELECT bin, count(*) AS cells, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY cov50) AS median_cov50, min(cov50) AS min_cov50, max(cov50) AS max_cov50, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY cov10) AS median_cov10, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY band) AS median_band, min(band) AS min_band, max(band) AS max_band, min(n) AS n_per_cell, max(n) AS max_n_per_cell FROM x GROUP BY bin ORDER BY CASE bin WHEN '1s' THEN 1 WHEN '15s' THEN 2 WHEN '1min' THEN 3 END
raw.claimed: Median coverage sits near 0.45; the lower edge is distorted by zero-ties (the p10 frequently touches zero on bursty signals), which also deflates the nominal-80% band, more so at finer bins
raw.evidence: Coarse-bin median coverage is 0.4695, while the finer 1s bins show sharply elevated lower-tail coverage (0.3075 versus nominal 0.10) and a deflated median band of 0.5905 versus 0.782 at 1min, consistently supporting the stated zero-tie/fine-bin effect.
